fact: ESA used Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery from 2015 and 2025 to show reclaimed irrigated cropland in Egypt's Western Desert, stating such data are useful for mapping land use, crop type and crop health.

FAO's WaPOR Phase 2 project, in partnership with Egypt's Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, produced a 10 m Sentinel-2 crop type map of Mallawi, Minya for 2023-2024, published 2026-06-24.

Daily News Egypt reports NARSS and the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation presented a crop map for the 2023-24 winter season, with each governorate using remote sensing data to inventory and classify wheat, clover and sugar beet.

Egypt Today reports the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources said a pilot of a satellite image analysis system producing crop type maps for irrigation water distribution and crop growth monitoring had begun in Kafr El Sheikh governorate.
